text: A muscular male figure with a brownish skin tone stands center-frame. He has dark, shoulder-length wavy hair and a broad face with heavy brow ridges and deep-set eyes. Bare-chested, he grips a red pole in his right hand while extending his left arm outward. His pose suggests tension or confrontation. Behind him looms a translucent white humanoid figure holding a similar pole. The background is abstract blue and icy textures.
